source_of_truth: Read by hand from app/components/nav/MediaBar.vue (Vue SFC, semantic engine). Every control is correct and each is a known false-positive trap for a different a11y rule: the icon-only
provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from source without consulting tool output

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the icon-only button has a static aria-label ("Open menu"), which is its accessible name.
one image is role="presentation" (decorative, removed from the a11y tree) and the other has alt="" (explicitly decorative); neither needs a description.
the <a> has a real href and visible text; it is navigation, not a click-handler link.
the hover row has both @mouseenter and @focus, so keyboard users get the same behaviour.
the table contains <th scope="col"> header cells.
aria-hidden="true" is on a decorative <svg>, which is not a focusable element.
